description: API gateway qa profile (Railway internal DNS routing, no Eureka) PLUS findu-core qa profile and its single allowed Java change. These are the two highest-risk, most interconnected pieces: the gateway is the critical entry point and must stop using lb:// since there is no Eureka on Railway, and findu-core carries the only Java change (extract hardcoded notification-processor URL to a @Value property). Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 at the file level; ordered first by risk/importance.
steps: Read context.json first, then ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml and SECURITY/findu-spring-security/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml (style reference).

Create ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml. Set server.port: ${PORT:8080}. Under spring.cloud.gateway set discovery.locator.enabled: false. Preserve the base globalcors cors-configurations block and the default-filters DedupeResponseHeader filter. Recreate ALL routes keeping ids/predicates/paths but replacing each lb:// uri with a Railway internal DNS env var: security-auth-route -> ${SECURITY_SERVICE_URI:http://findu-spring-security.railway.internal:8081} (Path=/security-auth/**); authorization-server-route -> ${OAUTH2_SERVICE_URI:http://autorization-server-oauth2.railway.internal:9595} (Path=/authorization-server/**); findu-core-route -> ${CORE_SERVICE_URI:http://findu-core.railway.internal:8082} (Path=/findu-core/**); findu-transaction-route -> ${TRANSACTION_SERVICE_URI:http://findu-transaction.railway.internal:8084} (Path=/findu-transaction/**, /internal/**); findu-help-route -> ${HELP_SERVICE_URI:http://findu-help-v2.railway.internal:8085} (Path=/findu-help-v2/**); notification-dispatcher-route -> ${DISPATCHER_SERVICE_URI:http://findu-notification-dispatcher.railway.internal:9000} (Path=/ws/events/**, /notification-dispatcher/**). Add the Eureka-disable block (eureka.client.enabled/register-with-eureka/fetch-registry all false).

Edit CORE/findu-core/src/main/java/com/findu/core/application/service/GestionPerfilProveedorUseCaseImpl.java: add a non-final field annotated with @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${findu.notification.processor.base-url:http://findu-notification-processor.railway.internal:8083}") named notificationProcessorBaseUrl (non-final so @RequiredArgsConstructor does not turn it into a constructor arg), and in notificarDispatcherDisponibilidad build the URL as notificationProcessorBaseUrl + "/api/v1/canales/proveedor/disponibilidad" instead of the hardcoded literal. Make NO other code changes. If this proves more invasive than a field+concatenation, revert the Java edit, leave the literal, and record the pending item in findings.

Create CORE/findu-core/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml: server.port: ${PORT:8082}; spring.datasource url/username/password from SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL/USERNAME/PASSWORD with driver-class-name org.postgresql.Driver; spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto: none; spring.sql.init.mode: ${SPRING_SQL_INIT_MODE:never}; spring.data.redis.host/port from SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST/PORT; findu.cache.enabled from FINDU_CACHE_ENABLED default true; findu.notification.enabled/lambda-url kept env-driven; findu.notification.processor.base-url default http://findu-notification-processor.railway.internal:8083; add the Eureka-disable block. Keep config.import optional (inherited from base; do not duplicate unless needed).
acceptance_criteria: ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml exists, contains no lb:// uris, sets discovery.locator.enabled: false, keeps all 6 route ids with their original predicates/paths, preserves globalcors and default-filters, sets server.port: ${PORT:8080}, and disables Eureka.
CORE/findu-core/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml exists with Postgres/Redis via env vars, sql.init.mode never, and the Eureka-disable block.

GestionPerfilProveedorUseCaseImpl.java no longer contains the hardcoded string http://findu-notification-processor:8083 and instead reads the base URL from the findu.notification.processor.base-url property (or, if reverted, findings documents why).
`.\gradlew.bat clean bootJar -x test --no-daemon` succeeds in ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway and `.\gradlew.bat clean compileJava -x test --no-daemon` succeeds in CORE/findu-core.
verification: cd ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway && .\gradlew.bat clean bootJar -x test --no-daemon  (expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
cd CORE/findu-core && .\gradlew.bat clean compileJava -x test --no-daemon  (expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
findings: Java change APPLIED (not reverted): added non-final field notificationProcessorBaseUrl annotated @Value("${findu.notification.processor.base-url:http://findu-notification-processor.railway.internal:8083}") in GestionPerfilProveedorUseCaseImpl; notificarDispatcherDisponibilidad now builds the URL via notificationProcessorBaseUrl + "/api/v1/canales/proveedor/disponibilidad". The old hardcoded literal http://findu-notification-processor:8083 is gone. Field is non-final so @RequiredArgsConstructor does not add it as a constructor arg. Created ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml (6 routes keep ids/predicates/paths, lb:// replaced by *_SERVICE_URI env vars with railway.internal defaults, discovery.locator.enabled=false, globalcors + DedupeResponseHeader preserved, server.port=${PORT:8080}, Eureka disabled). Created CORE/findu-core/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml (Postgres via SPRING_DATASOURCE_*, driver org.postgresql.Driver, ddl-auto none, sql.init.mode ${SPRING_SQL_INIT_MODE:never}, Redis via spring.data.redis.host/port, findu.cache.enabled, findu.notification.enabled/lambda-url env-driven, findu.notification.processor.base-url default railway.internal:8083, Eureka disabled). config.import inherited from base (not duplicated). No *_ENDPOINT vars set; no hardcoded hosts. VERIFIED: api-gateway `bootJar` BUILD SUCCESSFUL; findu-core `compileJava` BUILD SUCCESSFUL (both -x test --no-daemon).
